sectiontype.name: zoe
sectiontype.description: A ZOE storage in this process: zoe.Storage. Each key has an environment variable, its twin. The twin is "ZOE_" and the key in upper case, with "_" for "-". The twin gives the value only when the section does not set the key. An empty value counts as not set. The twin takes the same values as the key. ZConfig gives each value as text, and zoe.config converts it, so that an empty value of any key reaches the twin.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store. The storage creates it when it is missing. The section or ZOE_PATH must give it. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: blob-dir
key.description: The directory of the blob files. The default is the blobs directory in path. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: backend
key.description: The backend of the store. The only backend is redb, the default.

key.name: lock-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a vote waits for the lock of an object, in whole seconds, 0 or more, such as 10s or 2m. A longer wait raises ConflictError. The default is the default of the store.

key.name: early-locks
key.description: Early write-intent locks. The storage has none yet: off is the only value, and the default.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the storage refuses writes and does not create a missing directory. The default is false.

sectiontype.name: storage
sectiontype.description: A store that zoe serve serves under the name of the section, such as main for "<storage main>": a [storages.NAME] table of the configuration file of zoe serve.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store. The server creates it when it is missing, except for a read-only store. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: blob-dir
key.description: The directory of the blob files. The default is the blobs directory in path. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the server serves this store for reads only.

sectiontype.name: zoe-server
sectiontype.description: The settings of zoe serve. "python -m zoe.serve -C FILE" reads this section and runs the zoe binary with them. The keys other than binary are the options of zoe serve without "--", as in its configuration file, and take the syntax of the option. Each option has an environment variable, its twin. The twin gives the value only when the section does not set the key. An empty value counts as not set.

key.name: binary
key.description: The zoe binary to run. The default is ZOE_BINARY, else the zoe binary on the PATH.

key.name: path
key.description: The directory of the store of the storage name 1. A leading ~ is the home directory.

key.name: listen
key.description: The address of the ZEO port, as HOST:PORT. A port of 0 takes a free port. The default is 127.0.0.1:8100.

key.name: admin-listen
key.description: The address of the admin port, as HOST:PORT. Without it, the server opens no admin port.

key.name: invalidation-queue-size
key.description: The most transactions that getInvalidations covers.

key.name: client-queue-size
key.description: The most invalidations that wait for one client.

key.name: cache-size
key.description: The most bytes that the page cache of each store holds, such as 512MB or 1GB. The default is 1GB.

key.name: lock-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a vote waits for the lock of an object, in whole seconds, such as 10s or 2m.

key.name: max-frame-size
key.description: The longest frame that a client can send, in bytes.

key.name: shutdown-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a stop on SIGTERM takes, in whole seconds.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: The longest time that a connection sends no frame, in whole seconds. 0 closes no idle connection.

key.name: lock-warn
key.description: Log each lock held longer than this, in whole seconds. 0 logs no lock.

key.name: transaction-warn
key.description: Log each transaction open longer than this, in whole seconds. 0 logs no transaction.

key.name: log-format
key.description: The format of the log lines on stderr: text, or json for one JSON object on each line.

key.name: read-only
key.description: If true, the server serves every store for reads only. The default is false.

multisection.description: The named stores. The name of each section is its storage name.
